client: I've been feeling really anxious lately because I failed two exams this semester, and now I'm worried about whether I'll be able to graduate on time. It feels like everything is piling up, and I'm not sure how to handle it. Sometimes I wonder if talking about it in therapy will even make a difference.
therapist: It sounds like you’re feeling really overwhelmed right now, especially with the pressure of your exams and the uncertainty about graduating. I can sense that there's a lot of worry and doubt, and it’s understandable to feel anxious when things seem to be piling up. Talking about these feelings can be a valuable step, even if it feels uncertain. Let’s explore what’s on your mind together and see how we can lighten this load.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, very rapid speech
